newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Congressman wants to rescind milk pact.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Congressman wants to rescind milk pact.

text.p: U.S. Representative Jim Oberstar said Thursday he had co-sponsored legislation to rescind the Northeast Interstate Dairy Compact, saying it adversely affected dairy farmers and consumers in Minnesota.

The legislation would expressly rescind the compact because regional disparities in dairy prices could lead to the extinction of small-herd dairy farms in his state, said Oberstar, a Minnesota Democrat.
Under the compact, the federal government would have to purchase excess milk production in New England, allowing New England farmers effectively to regulate fluid milk prices, Oberstar said.
